node: Hidden auto OEM supplier dependency and pricing-stress chokepoints
summary: Expanded the universe around auto OEM supplier-dependency and pricing-stress chokepoints with a two-lane funnel. Reference lane uses Lear as a visible example of share shifts from incumbent suppliers on OEM platforms. Underfollowed lane focuses on smaller public suppliers where customer concentration, platform exposure, aftermarket substitution, or consolidation potential could become visible if OEM-supplier disputes move from contractual pressure to production disruption. Current evidence supports the node as a watchlist hypothesis rather than a confirmed operational shock.
